name: plantuml-diagrams
title: PlantUML
description: Draw PlantUML diagrams in issues, comments and Knowledge Base articles. Insert a PlantUML block from the editor toolbar and type the diagram source. The diagram is rendered in your browser when you save it: the source is not sent to a server, and readers see the saved image without loading a diagram engine. C4 diagrams are supported. In projects that the app is attached to, an item in the issue and article menu replaces ```plantuml code blocks with diagrams and back.
changeNotes:
Version 1.1.0

  • Feature: The diagram is rendered when you save it. Readers see the saved diagram and do not load the diagram engine
  • Feature: The editor renders each diagram only once until you change its source
  • Change: To convert ```plantuml code blocks, select PlantUML code blocks → Convert to diagrams in the options menu of the issue or article. The text changes only when you select an action. The panel below the summary and the automatic conversion on save are removed

Version 1.0.0

  • Feature: PlantUML block in the editor (Images and embedded content → PlantUML) with a live preview
  • Feature: Diagrams are rendered in the browser; the diagram source is not sent to a server
  • Feature: C4-PlantUML library (!include <C4/...>)
  • Feature: Light and dark theme
  • Optional: in projects that the app is attached to, a one-line panel converts ```plantuml code blocks to diagrams and back. An issue or article changes only after a user selects Convert to diagrams for it
